name: whimlet
description: Whimlet — handmade crochet products & custom crochet orders. Boutique 3D marketing site.

scripts.test:design: tsc --module commonjs --target es2020 --skipLibCheck --outDir node_modules/.design-test src/lib/design.ts src/lib/sketch.ts && node scripts/design-tests.mjs node_modules/.design-test
scripts.test:maker: tsc --module commonjs --target es2020 --skipLibCheck --outDir node_modules/.maker-test src/lib/maker.ts src/lib/sculpt.ts && node scripts/maker-tests.mjs node_modules/.maker-test
scripts.test:engine: tsc --module commonjs --target es2020 --skipLibCheck --outDir node_modules/.engine-test src/lib/engine/scheduler.ts src/lib/engine/android.ts src/lib/engine/capability.ts && node scripts/engine-tests.mjs node_modules/.engine-test
scripts.test: npm run test:design && npm run test:maker && npm run test:engine
